about.title: About Me
about.paragraph1: I'm a Full Stack developer specialized in Angular and Java Spring Boot. I've worked in enterprise environments and on the modernization of banking applications, helping migrate systems from Informix 4GL to more current architectures built around REST APIs, SQL and a modular codebase.
about.paragraph2: I'm interested in building software that is useful, maintainable and well thought out, looking at the full context: business, architecture, data and user experience. I use AI as a support tool to speed up legacy-system analysis, uncover patterns, challenge decisions and move faster on refactoring and documentation without outsourcing technical judgment.

portfolio.title: Portfolio

project1.title: yoelvilla.dev
project1.description: Personal portfolio with serverless architecture. Frontend deployed on S3 + CloudFront, backend with Lambda + API Gateway. Custom translation system, personalized cursor and integrated contact form.

project2.title: Route Designer
project2.description: Mountain route planner and analyzer. Track editor with topographic layers, DEM-based elevation profiling and automatic slope analysis. Frontend deployed on Cloudflare Workers and backend on Railway with SQLite cache and rate limiting.

portfolio.experience1: Angular/Java Developer at Métrica (May 2025 - February 2026): I worked on the modernization of banking applications for Banco Santander as part of a migration from Informix 4GL to a Java architecture with a hexagonal approach. I contributed to the project's base structure, REST service development and integration with Informix and Oracle, helping turn legacy business logic into services that were easier to maintain and evolve.
portfolio.experience2: Angular Developer at IRM Analytics (May 2024 - May 2025): I built frontend applications for business users working with large data volumes. I improved browser-side performance with Web Workers and IndexedDB, and developed dashboards, maps and interactive graphs that made complex information easier to explore and faster to act on.
